evidence: Changes src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp and unbundles BlockManager ownership from ChainstateManager to allow kernel consumers to manage block storage independently.
rationale: Decoupling block storage ownership from ChainstateManager directly unblocks kernel callers from operating on pruned directories independently (#35627, #36856). Moving block storage out of monolithic chainstate management addresses a key architectural prerequisite for a modular kernel library.
